description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a UI fragment that contains a LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages view creation, layout, and updates to the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that displays a log view and manages its layout and updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom when text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
